```
Self-hosted PageSpeed Insights dashboard — Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse scores, CrUX monitoring & multi-site web performance tracking. Node.js + JSON storage.
```

## Social preview

GitHub auto-generates from README. Ensure README first paragraph contains: PageSpeed Insights, Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, self-hosted dashboard.

## For AI discoverability

This repo includes `llms.txt` at the root — a standard file AI crawlers and assistants use to understand the project. Link to it from README (already done).
